label: About
title: About Too Large to Close
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 27 recent saved-signal files and 1 captured links, then narrowed the page to 1 source windows around Dido Pynell — layered drawing reference. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Too Large to Close: Landscape collage-drawing on pale scuffed ground: two disconnected plum loop clusters, a dense left knot with a broad scratched pinch and a sparse right pair. Across an erased corridor, two unequal tiny back-facing skirted fragments stand apart, one touching a loop, one outside; one wears a pale top. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 1 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against Dense plum pigment junction at the inner edge of the left loop cluster and Broad plum pinched loop junction threaded with scratches and cyan-green traces.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
